articles.title: Happy Money
articles.topic: 幸福消费：把钱花在体验上远比购物更值得
articles.source: 2014 年考研英语（二）Text 1 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: What would you do with $590m?
sentences.cn: 你会用 5.9 亿美元做什么？

sentences.en: This is now a question for Gloria MacKenzie, an 84-year-old widow who recently emerged from her small, tin-roofed house in Florida to collect the biggest undivided lottery jackpot in history.
sentences.cn: 这是如今摆在歌莉娅·麦肯齐面前的问题。她是一位 84 岁寡居老人，住在佛罗里达一间狭窄铁皮屋里，最近因独揽史上最高金额彩票头奖并现身领奖而为人所关注。

sentences.en: If she hopes her new-found fortune will yield lasting feelings of fulfilment, she could do worse than read Happy Money by Elizabeth Dunn and Michael Norton.
sentences.cn: 如果她希望这笔新到手的财富能够产生长久满足感，倒不妨读读伊丽莎白·邓恩与迈克·诺顿合著的《快乐金钱》。

sentences.en: These two academics use an array of behavioral research to show that the most rewarding ways to spend money can be counterintuitive.
sentences.cn: 这两位学者运用一系列行为研究表明，最有意义的花钱方式可能是与直觉相反的。

sentences.en: Fantasies of great wealth often involve visions of fancy cars and extravagant homes.
sentences.cn: 对于巨额财富的幻想通常会伴随着对“炫车豪宅”的憧憬。

sentences.en: Yet satisfaction with these material purchases wears off fairly quickly.
sentences.cn: 然而，这些物质购买所带来的满足感会消失得相当快。

sentences.en: What was once exciting and new becomes old-hat; regret creeps in.
sentences.cn: 曾经令人兴奋又新奇的东西变得陈旧过时，懊悔悄然而至。

sentences.en: It is far better to spend money on experiences, say Ms Dunn and Mr Norton, like interesting trips, unique meals or even going to the cinema.
sentences.cn: 邓恩女士和诺顿先生说道，远不如把钱花在“体验”上，比如说有趣的旅行、独特的餐食、甚至是去看电影。

sentences.en: These purchases often become more valuable with time - as stories or memories - particularly if they involve feeling more connected to others.
sentences.cn: 随着时间的流逝，这些体验往往会变得更加珍贵——以记忆或故事的形式——尤其是当它们让人感觉到自己与他人联系更紧密时。

sentences.en: This slim volume is packed with tips to help wage slaves as well as lottery winners get the most "happiness bang for your buck."
sentences.cn: 这本小书满载各种建议，帮助“工薪奴隶”和彩票中奖者们用每一分钱换来最多的快乐。

sentences.en: It seems most people would be better off if they could shorten their commutes to work, spend more time with friends and family and less of it watching television (something the average American spends a whopping two months a year doing, and is hardly jollier for it).
sentences.cn: 似乎大部分人都能通过缩短通勤时间、多陪家人朋友、少看电视（美国人年均竟然有两个月的时间在看电视，却并没有因此更快乐）而过得更好。

sentences.en: Buying gifts or giving to charity is often more pleasurable than purchasing things for oneself, and luxuries are most enjoyable when they are consumed sparingly.
sentences.cn: 给他人买礼物或捐款给慈善机构通常比给自己买东西更令人愉悦，有节制地消费奢侈品才能带来最大快乐。

sentences.en: This is apparently the reason McDonald's restricts the availability of its popular McRib - a marketing trick that has turned the pork sandwich into an object of obsession.
sentences.cn: 显然这正是麦当劳限量供应大受欢迎的烤汁猪排堡的原因所在——这一营销手段已将这种猪肉三明治变成了令人痴迷之物。

sentences.en: Readers of Happy Money are clearly a privileged lot, anxious about fulfilment, not hunger.
sentences.cn: 《快乐金钱》的读者显然属于一个幸运的群体，渴望得到满足感，而不是担心挨饿。

words.meaning: 一群享有特权/优渥的人

sentences.en: Money may not quite buy happiness, but people in wealthier countries are generally happier than those in poor ones.
sentences.cn: 金钱或许不能真正买到幸福，但富裕国家的人们总体上比贫穷国家的人们更幸福。

sentences.en: Yet the link between feeling good and spending money on others can be seen among rich and poor people around the world, and scarcity enhances the pleasure of most things for most people.
sentences.cn: 然而，全世界范围内，无论穷人还是富人中，都可以看到“将钱用到别人身上”和“感觉愉悦”的联系，且对大部分人来讲，稀缺性提升了大部分事物的愉悦感。

sentences.en: Not everyone will agree with the authors' policy ideas, which range from mandating more holiday time to reducing tax incentives for American homebuyers.
sentences.cn: 并非所有人都会赞同作者从“增加假日时间”到“降低对美国购房者的税收刺激”等政策理念。

sentences.en: But most people will come away from this book believing it was money well spent.
sentences.cn: 但大部分人读完此书后都会认为，它非常值得购买。

words.meaning: 读完/离开后（有某种感受）

questions.stem: According to Dunn and Norton, which of the following is the most rewarding purchase?
questions.stem_cn: 根据邓恩和诺顿的观点，下列哪一项是最令人满足的消费？

options_cn.A: 一栋大房子。
options_cn.C: 一辆时髦的汽车。
options_cn.D: 一顿丰盛的大餐。

questions.explanation: 第二段指出把钱花在“体验”上最令人满足，如有趣的旅行、独特的美食或看电影；[B] 的 special tour 正是“旅行”这类体验消费，故为答案。[A][C] 属被否定的物质购买，[D] 的 meal 虽被提及，但选项强调 rich（丰盛），偏离“独特体验”之意。

questions.stem: The author's attitude toward Americans' watching TV is ___.
questions.stem_cn: 作者对美国人看电视的态度是___。

options_cn.A: 批评的
options_cn.C: 同情的
options_cn.D: 含糊的

questions.explanation: 第三段以括号补充说明普通美国人一年花两个月看电视，却“几乎并未因此更快乐”（hardly jollier for it），流露出对这一行为的批评态度，故选 [A]。

questions.stem: McRib is mentioned in Paragraph 3 to show that ___.
questions.stem_cn: 第三段提到“麦肋排堡”是为了说明___。

options_cn.A: 消费者有时并不理性
options_cn.C: 营销手段往往奏效
options_cn.D: 稀缺通常会增加愉悦

questions.explanation: 麦肋排堡的例子紧承“奢侈品在节制享用时最令人享受”之论断，说明限量供应制造了稀缺，从而提升了愉悦感，[D] 正确。[C] 虽提及 marketing trick，但该例证的落脚点是“稀缺提升愉悦”，而非营销本身。

questions.stem: According to the last paragraph, Happy Money ___.
questions.stem_cn: 根据最后一段，《幸福的金钱》___。

options.A: has left much room for readers' criticism
options.B: may prove to be a worthwhile purchase
options.C: has predicted a wider income gap in the US
options.D: may give its readers a sense of achievement

options_cn.A: 给读者留下了很多批评的空间
options_cn.B: 可能被证明是一次值得的购买
options_cn.C: 预言了美国收入差距会扩大
options_cn.D: 可能给读者带来成就感

questions.explanation: 末段末句指出大多数人读完此书都会认为“这钱花得值”（money well spent），[B] 的 worthwhile purchase 与之同义，故为答案。

questions.stem: This text mainly discusses how to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 本文主要讨论如何___。

options.A: balance feeling good and spending money
options.B: spend large sums of money won in lotteries
options.C: obtain lasting satisfaction from money spent
options.D: become more reasonable in spending on luxuries

options_cn.A: 在愉悦感与花钱之间取得平衡
options_cn.C: 从花出去的钱中获得持久的满足
options_cn.D: 在奢侈品消费上更理性

questions.explanation: 全文围绕“如何花钱才能带来持久满足”展开，反复出现 pleasure、feeling good 等主旨词，[C] 恰当概括，故为答案。

articles.title: The Above Average Effect
articles.topic: 自我美化：我们眼中的自己比真实更漂亮
articles.source: 2014 年考研英语（二）Text 2 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: An article in Scientific American has pointed out that empirical research says that, actually, you think you're more beautiful than you are.
sentences.cn: 《科学美国人》上的一篇文章指出：实证研究表明，事实上你会把自己想得比实际上漂亮。

sentences.en: We have a deep-seated need to feel good about ourselves and we naturally employ a number of self-enhancing strategies to achieve this.
sentences.cn: 我们有一种根深蒂固的需求，让自我感觉良好，而且自然而然地运用许多自我拉抬策略去达成此目的。

sentences.en: Social psychologists have amassed oceans of research into what they call the "above average effect", or "illusory superiority", and shown that, for example, 70% of us rate ourselves as above average in leadership, 93% in driving and 85% at getting on well with others - all obviously statistical impossibilities.
sentences.cn: 社会心理学家就其所称的“高于均数效应”或“虚幻的优越感”收集了大量的研究，并指出，我们当中有 70% 的人自认为领导力高于常人，93% 的人自认为驾驶能力高于常人，85% 的人自认为与人相处高于常人——而这些显然在统计学上都是不可能的。

sentences.en: We rose-tint our memories and put ourselves into self-affirming situations.
sentences.cn: 我们美化记忆以使自己身处自我肯定状态。

words.meaning: 美化，把……描绘得过于美好

sentences.en: We become defensive when criticised, and apply negative stereotypes to others to boost our own esteem.
sentences.cn: 被批评时我们变得心存戒备，并用消极成见对待他人以增强自己的自尊。

sentences.en: We stalk around thinking we're hot stuff.
sentences.cn: 我们趾高气昂，自认为很有魅力。

sentences.en: Psychologist and behavioural scientist Nicholas Epley oversaw a key study into self-enhancement and attractiveness.
sentences.cn: 心理学家兼行为科学家尼古拉斯·艾普里对一项有关自我拉抬和吸引力的关键研究进行了监督。

words.meaning: v. 主持，监管（oversee 的过去式）
n. 自我美化，自我提升

sentences.en: Rather than have people simply rate their beauty compared with others, he asked them to identify an original photograph of themselves from a lineup including versions that had been altered to appear more and less attractive.
sentences.cn: 艾普里没有让人们直接将自己的美貌与别人比对，而是让他们从一组被修改过的照片中识别出自己的原始照片，被修改的照片增加或减少了他们的吸引力。

words.meaning: n. （供辨认的）一组照片/人物

sentences.en: Visual recognition, reads the study, is "an automatic psychological process, occurring rapidly and intuitively with little or no apparent conscious deliberation".
sentences.cn: 该研究显示，视觉识别是“自动心理过程，这一过程依靠直觉快速发生，几乎没有或者没有明显的刻意考虑”。

sentences.en: If the subjects quickly chose a falsely flattering image - which most did - they genuinely believed it was really how they looked.
sentences.cn: 受试者要是迅速选择了一张虚假的美图——大部分受试者都这么选——他们打心底真是觉着这张照片就是他们真实的样子。

sentences.en: Epley found no significant gender difference in responses.
sentences.cn: 艾普里发现，回答中并无明显的性别差异。

sentences.en: Nor was there any evidence that those who self-enhanced the most (that is, the participants who thought the most positively doctored pictures were real) were doing so to make up for profound insecurities.
sentences.cn: 也没有任何证据表明，那些自我拉抬程度最高的人（即那些认为被过度美化的照片是真实的参与者）这样做是为了弥补深层的不安全感。

sentences.en: In fact, those who thought that the images higher up the attractiveness scale were real directly corresponded with those who showed other markers for having higher self-esteem.
sentences.cn: 事实上，那些认为吸引力评分更高的照片是真实的人，恰恰与那些表现出其他高自尊标志的人相吻合。

sentences.en: "I don't think the findings that we have are any evidence of personal delusion," says Epley.
sentences.cn: 艾普里说：“我认为我们的发现根本不能证明个人存在妄想。”

sentences.en: "It's a reflection simply of people generally thinking well of themselves."
sentences.cn: “它仅仅反映了人们普遍自我感觉良好。”

sentences.en: If you are depressed, you won't be self-enhancing.
sentences.cn: 如果你情绪低落，就不会进行自我拉抬。

words.meaning: adj. 情绪低落的，抑郁的

sentences.en: Knowing the results of Epley's study, it makes sense that many people hate photographs of themselves viscerally - on one level, they don't even recognise the person in the picture as themselves.
sentences.cn: 了解了艾普里的研究结果，就明白许多人为什么打心眼里反感自己的真实照片——在某种程度上，他们甚至没有意识到照片上的人就是自己。

words.meaning: adv. 本能地，发自内心地

sentences.en: Facebook, therefore, is a self-enhancer's paradise, where people can share only the most flattering photos, the cream of their wit, style, beauty, intellect and lifestyles.
sentences.cn: 因此，Facebook 就成为了自我拉抬者的乐园，用户们可以只在上面分享自己最美的照片以及他们的风趣、风格、美丽、才智和生活方式的精华部分。

sentences.en: It's not that people's profiles are dishonest, says Catalina Toma of Wisconsin-Madison University, "but they portray an idealised version of themselves."
sentences.cn: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的凯特莉娜·托马说，“这并不是说人们在自身形象上不诚实，而是他们为自己绘制了一幅理想画像”。

questions.stem: According to the first paragraph, social psychologists have found that ___.
questions.stem_cn: 根据第一段，社会心理学家发现___。

options.B: illusory superiority is a baseless effect
options.C: our need for leadership is unnatural

options_cn.A: 我们的自我评分高得不切实际
options_cn.B: 虚幻的优越感是一种毫无根据的效应
options_cn.C: 我们对领导力的需求是不自然的
options_cn.D: 自我美化策略是无效的

questions.explanation: 第一段举出 70%、93%、85% 等数据，说明人们普遍把自己评价为“高于平均”，而这些在统计上不可能同时成立，即自我评分过高不切实际，[A] 正确。

questions.stem: Visual recognition is believed to be people's ___.
questions.stem_cn: 视觉识别被认为是人们的___。

options_cn.A: 快速匹配
options_cn.C: 直觉反应
options_cn.D: 自动自我防御

questions.explanation: 第三段引用研究指出视觉识别是“快速、凭直觉发生、几乎不需有意识思考”的自动过程，intuitively 对应 [C] 的 intuitive response，故选 [C]。

questions.stem: Epley found that people with higher self-esteem tended to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 埃普利发现，自尊更高的人倾向于___。

options_cn.A: 低估自己的不安感
options_cn.C: 掩盖自己的抑郁
options_cn.D: 过度简化自己的妄想

questions.explanation: 第四段指出，那些认为“吸引力更高的图片才是真”的人与“自尊更高”的人直接对应，即自尊高的人倾向于相信自身吸引力，[B] 正确。

questions.stem: The word "viscerally" (Line 2, Para.5) is closest in meaning to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 第五段第二行中的 "viscerally" 一词意思最接近于___。

options_cn.A: 本能地
options_cn.C: 特别地
options_cn.D: 咄咄逼人地

questions.explanation: viscerally 意为“发自内心地、本能地”，与上下文“人们本能地不喜欢自己的真实照片”逻辑一致，[A] instinctively（本能地）与之同义，故为答案。

questions.stem: It can be inferred that Facebook is a self-enhancer's paradise because people can ___.
questions.stem_cn: 可以推断，Facebook 是自我美化者的天堂，因为人们可以___。

options_cn.A: 展示不诚实的个人资料
options_cn.B: 界定他们传统的生活方式
options_cn.C: 分享他们的智力追求
options_cn.D: 隐藏自己不讨人喜欢的一面

questions.explanation: 第五段指出人们在 Facebook 上只分享最讨人喜欢、最精华的照片，即隐藏不讨人喜欢的一面，[D] 正确。[A] 与末句“并非个人资料不诚实”相反。

articles.title: Man Versus Machine
articles.topic: 人机之争：与机器同跑而非赛跑
articles.source: 2014 年考研英语（二）Text 3 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: The concept of man versus machine is at least as old as the industrial revolution, but this phenomenon tends to be most acutely felt during economic downturns and fragile recoveries.
sentences.cn: “人机矛盾”这一概念至少可以上溯到工业革命时期，但这一现象在经济下滑且复苏乏力的情形下给人的感受最为强烈。

sentences.en: And yet, it would be a mistake to think we are right now simply experiencing the painful side of a boom and bust cycle.
sentences.cn: 然而，那种认为“我们现在仅仅是处于繁荣与萧条循环周期的令人痛苦的一面”的想法是个错误。

sentences.en: Certain jobs have gone away for good, outmoded by machines.
sentences.cn: 因使用机器而过时的某些工作已永远地消失了。

sentences.en: Since technology has such an insatiable appetite for eating up human jobs, this phenomenon will continue to restructure our economy in ways we cannot immediately foresee.
sentences.cn: 由于技术在吞噬人类工作方面非常“贪得无厌”，所以这一现象将会继续以难以即时预料的方式重构我们的经济。

sentences.en: When there is rapid improvement in the price and performance of technology, jobs that were once thought to be immune from automation suddenly become threatened.
sentences.cn: 当技术在价格、性能方面大为改善时，那些曾经被认为对自动化免疫的工作也就会突然受到威胁。

sentences.en: This argument has attracted a lot of attention, via the success of the book Race Against the Machine, by Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee, who both hail from MIT's Center for Digital Business.
sentences.cn: 这一观点得益于《与机器赛跑》一书的热卖，已获得广泛关注。该书两位作者埃里克·布伦乔尔森与安德鲁·迈克菲均来自麻省理工学院数字化商业中心。

sentences.en: This is a powerful argument, and a scary one.
sentences.cn: 这是个很有说服力，但又让人恐慌的观点。

sentences.en: And yet, John Hagel, author of The Power of Pull and other books, says Brynjolfsson and McAfee miss the reason why these jobs are so vulnerable to technology in the first place.
sentences.cn: 然而，著有《拉动力》和其他书作的约翰·哈格尔认为，布伦乔尔森和迈克菲忽视了这些工作在技术面前不堪一击的根本原因。

words.meaning: 易受……伤害的，对……不堪一击

sentences.en: Hagel says we have designed jobs in the U.S. that tend to be "tightly scripted" and "highly standardized" ones that leave no room for "individual initiative or creativity".
sentences.cn: 哈格尔说，在美国，我们往往把工作设计成“高度模式化”、“高度标准化”，以至于没给人们留下“发挥个人主动性和创造力”的空间。

words.meaning: 高度模式化、按脚本行事的

sentences.en: In short, these are the types of jobs that machines can perform much better at than human beings.
sentences.cn: 简言之，这些工作属于“机器可以比人类做得好出许多”的类型。

sentences.en: That is how we have put a giant target sign on the backs of American workers, Hagel says.
sentences.cn: 哈格尔说，这就是我们在美国工人背上贴上巨大攻打标靶的方式。

sentences.en: It's time to reinvent the formula for how work is conducted, since we are still relying on a very 20th century notion of work, Hagel says.
sentences.cn: 哈格尔认为，是时候彻底改造我们的工作模式了，因为我们对工作的认知还停留在 20 世纪。

sentences.en: In our rapidly changing economy, we more than ever need people in the workplace who can take initiative and exercise their imagination "to respond to unexpected events".
sentences.cn: 在经济形势迅速转变的今天，我们比以往任何时候都更需要那些在工作中可以发挥主动性、运用想象力“以应付突发事件”的人才。

sentences.en: That is not something machines are good at.
sentences.cn: 那是机器所不擅长的事情。

sentences.en: They are designed to perform very predictable activities.
sentences.cn: 它们被设计为执行非常容易预测的行为。

sentences.en: As Hagel notes, Brynjolfsson and McAfee indeed touched on this point in their book.
sentences.cn: 正如哈格尔所指出的，布伦乔尔森和迈克菲确实在他们书中提到了这一点。

sentences.en: We need to reframe race against the machine as race with the machine.
sentences.cn: 我们需要把“与机器赛跑”的概念转换成“与机器同跑”。

words.meaning: v. 重新界定，重新表述

sentences.en: When the government talks about infrastructure contributing to the economy the focus is usually on roads, railways, broadband and energy.
sentences.cn: 当政府谈及有助于经济的基础设施时，通常着眼于公路、铁路、宽带和能源，

sentences.en: Housing is seldom mentioned.
sentences.cn: 却很少提及住房。

sentences.en: Why is that?
sentences.cn: 这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: To some extent the housing sector must shoulder the blame.
sentences.cn: 在某种程度上，房地产行业必须承担责任。

sentences.en: We have not been good at communicating the real value that housing can contribute to economic growth.
sentences.cn: 一直以来我们不是很擅长传达住房对经济发展所贡献的真实价值。

sentences.en: Then there is the scale of the typical housing project.
sentences.cn: 再有一个是典型住房项目的规模。

sentences.en: It is hard to shove for attention among multibillion-pound infrastructure projects, so it is inevitable that the attention is focused elsewhere.
sentences.cn: （它们）很难在数十亿英镑的基础设施项目中获取注意力，因此，注意力集中在他处也在所难免。

sentences.en: But perhaps the most significant reason is that the issue has always been so politically charged.
sentences.cn: 但是也许最重要的原因是，这个问题一直受到严重政治制约。

words.meaning: 具有高度政治敏感性的

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the affordable housing situation is desperate.
sentences.cn: 然而，可支付住房形势却很严峻。

words.meaning: 可支付住房，经济适用房

sentences.en: Waiting lists increase all the time and we are simply not building enough new homes.
sentences.cn: 一方面，轮候名单一直在增加，另一方面，我们确实没有建造足够多的新房。

sentences.en: The comprehensive spending review offers an opportunity for the government to help rectify this.
sentences.cn: 综合开支审查给政府提供了一个调整这一状况的机会。

sentences.en: It needs to put historical prejudices to one side and take some steps to address our urgent housing need.
sentences.cn: 政府需要将历史偏见搁置一边，采取一些措施来解决我们迫切的住房需求。

sentences.en: There are some indications that it is preparing to do just that.
sentences.cn: 有迹象表明，政府正准备这样做。

sentences.en: The communities minister, Don Foster, has hinted that George Osborne, Chancellor of the Exchequer, may introduce more flexibility to the current cap on the amount that local authorities can borrow against their housing stock debt.
sentences.cn: 社区大臣唐·福斯特已经透露，财政大臣乔治·奥斯本可能对地方政府住房存量债务的借贷数额上限采取更大的灵活度。

words.meaning: n. （可用或可借资金的）上限

sentences.en: Evidence shows that 60,000 extra new homes could be built over the next five years if the cap were lifted, increasing GDP by 0.6%.
sentences.cn: 有证据表明，如果上限被提升，未来 5 年内将有另外 6 万套新房竣工，GDP 将提高 0.6%。

sentences.en: Ministers should also look at creating greater certainty in the rental environment, which would have a significant impact on the ability of registered providers to fund new developments from revenues.
sentences.cn: 部长大臣们还应该考虑提高房屋租赁市场的稳定性，这将对注册供应者凭借营业收入为新建住房提供资金的能力产生重大影响。

sentences.en: But it is not just down to the government.
sentences.cn: 但这不仅仅是政府的责任。

sentences.en: While these measures would be welcome in the short term, we must face up to the fact that the existing £4.5bn programme of grants to fund new affordable housing, set to expire in 2015, is unlikely to be extended beyond then.
sentences.cn: 尽管这些措施在短期内将受到欢迎，但是我们必须面对现实：目前用于投资新的可支付住房的 45 亿英镑拨款项目将于 2015 年到期，并且不可能延期。

sentences.en: The Labour party has recently announced that it will retain a large part of the coalition's spending plans if it returns to power.
sentences.cn: 工党最近宣布，如果重掌大权，它将保留大部分联合政府支出计划。

sentences.en: The housing sector needs to accept that we are very unlikely to ever return to the era of large-scale public grants.
sentences.cn: 房地产行业需要接受的事实是：我们回到大规模公共拨款时代的可能性很低。

sentences.en: We need to adjust to this changing climate.
sentences.cn: 我们需要适应这一变化的环境。

words.meaning: 不断变化的大环境/形势

sentences.en: While the government's commitment to long-term funding may have changed, the very pressing need for more affordable housing is real and is not going away.
sentences.cn: 尽管政府对长期资助的承诺可能已经生变，但人们对更多可支付住房的迫切需求是真实存在的，且不会消失。

sentences.en: Emerging in the late Sixties and reaching a peak in the Seventies, Land Art was one of a range of new forms, including Body Art, Performance Art, Action Art and Installation Art, which pushed art beyond the traditional confines of the studio and gallery.
sentences.cn: 地景艺术出现于六十年代末期，在七十年代达到顶峰，是包括身体艺术、行为艺术、偶发艺术及装置艺术在内的一系列新艺术形式中的一种，这些艺术形式将艺术推向了工作室和画廊的传统界限之外。

sentences.en: Rather than portraying landscape, land artists used the physical substance of the land itself as their medium.
sentences.cn: 地景艺术家不描绘风景，而是以土地本身的物质作为媒介。

sentences.en: The British land art, typified by Richard Long's piece, was not only more domestically scaled, but a lot quirkier than its American counterpart.
sentences.cn: 英国的地景艺术，以理查德·朗的作品为代表，不仅在国内更具规模，而且比美国地景艺术更加古怪离奇。

sentences.en: Indeed, while you might assume that an exhibition of Land Art would consist only of records of works rather than the works themselves, Long's photograph of his work is the work.
sentences.cn: 事实上，你或许认为一个地景艺术展览只包括作品的种种记录而非作品本身，但朗那些记录其工作的照片就是其作品。

sentences.en: Since his "action" is in the past, the photograph is its sole embodiment.
sentences.cn: 他的"行为"发生在过去，因而照片是这种行为的唯一体现。

sentences.en: That might seem rather an obscure point, but it sets the tone for an exhibition that contains a lot of black-and-white photographs and relatively few natural objects.
sentences.cn: 这一点可能显得相当晦涩，但它为这个包含大量黑白照片和相对较少自然物件的展览定下了基调。

sentences.en: Long is Britain's best-known Land Artist and his Stone Circle, a perfect ring of purplish rocks from Portishead beach laid out on the gallery floor, represents the elegant, rarefied side of the form.
sentences.cn: 朗是英国最著名的地景艺术家，他的《石环》——一个用波蒂斯黑德海滩的紫色岩石完美铺就的圆环，铺展在画廊地板上——代表了这一艺术形式优雅而高深的一面。

sentences.en: The Boyle Family, on the other hand, stand for its dirty, urban aspect.
sentences.cn: 另一方面，博伊尔家族则代表了它粗砺、都市化的一面。

sentences.en: Comprising artists Mark Boyle and Joan Hills and their children, they recreated random sections of the British landscape on gallery walls.
sentences.cn: 由艺术家马克·博伊尔和琼·希尔斯及其子女组成的这个家族，在画廊墙壁上重现了英国风景的随机片段。

sentences.en: Their Olaf Street Study, a square of brick-strewn waste ground, is one of the few works here to embrace the commonplaceness that characterises most of our experience of the landscape most of the time.
sentences.cn: 他们的《奥拉夫街研究》——一块铺满砖块的废地——是这里少数拥抱平庸的作品之一，而这种平庸正是我们大多数时候对景观体验的典型特征。

sentences.en: Parks feature, particularly in the earlier works, such as John Hilliard's very funny Across the Park, in which a long-haired stroller is variously smiled at by a pretty girl and unwittingly assaulted in a sequence of images that turn out to be different parts of the same photograph.
sentences.cn: 公园尤其出现在早期作品中，比如约翰·希利亚德那幅非常有趣的《漫步公园》，其中一位长发漫步者先后被一位漂亮女孩微笑、被无意间攻击，这一系列图像原来是同一张照片的不同部分。

sentences.en: Generally however British land artists preferred to get away from towns, gravitating towards landscapes that are traditionally considered beautiful such as the Lake District or the Wiltshire Downs.
sentences.cn: 不过总的来说，英国地景艺术家更喜欢远离城镇，倾向于那些传统上被认为美丽的风景，如湖区或威尔特郡丘陵。

sentences.en: While it probably wasn't apparent at the time, much of this work is permeated by a spirit of romantic escapism that the likes of Wordsworth would have readily understood.
sentences.cn: 虽然在当时可能并不明显，但这类作品大多弥漫着一种浪漫的逃避主义精神，华兹华斯之流会很容易理解。

sentences.en: Derek Jarman's yellow-tinted film Towards Avebury, a collection of long, mostly still shots of the Wiltshire landscape, evokes a tradition of English landscape painting stretching from Samuel Palmer to Paul Nash.
sentences.cn: 德里克·贾曼泛黄的影片《朝向埃夫伯里》——一组威尔特郡风景的长镜头、多为静态镜头——唤起了从塞缪尔·帕尔默到保罗·纳什的英国风景绘画传统。

sentences.en: In the case of Hamish Fulton, you can't help feeling that the Scottish artist has simply found a way of making his love of walking pay.
sentences.cn: 以哈米什·富尔顿为例，你忍不住会觉得这位苏格兰艺术家只是找到了一种让他的步行之爱有所回报的方式。

sentences.en: A typical work, such as Seven Days, consists of a single beautiful black-and-white photograph taken on an epic walk, with the mileage and number of days taken listed beneath.
sentences.cn: 像《七天》这样的典型作品由一张美丽的黑白照片组成，拍摄于一次史诗般的步行途中，照片下方列有里程数和所用天数。

sentences.en: British Land Art as shown in this well selected, but relatively modestly scaled exhibition wasn't about imposing on the landscape, more a kind of landscape-orientated light conceptual art created passing through.
sentences.cn: 正如这个精挑细选但规模相对适度的展览所展示的，英国地景艺术并非凌驾于风景之上，而更像是一种以风景为导向的光概念艺术，在穿行中创作。

sentences.en: It had its origins in the great outdoors, but the results were as gallery-bound as the paintings of Turner and Constable.
sentences.cn: 它起源于广阔的户外，但结果却与特纳和康斯特布尔的画作一样被局限在画廊之中。

articles.ref_cn: 大多数人都会把乐观定义为永远快乐，觉得杯子里总有半杯水。但这恰恰不是真正的快乐，积极心理学家们并不提倡。哈佛大学教授 Tal Ben-Shahar 说："健康的乐观意味着不脱离现实。"按照 Ben-Shahar 的说法，现实的乐观主义者是那些不管发生什么事情都力求从中得到最大收获的人，而不是那些指望凡事都有最好结局的人。Ben-Shahar 运用三种方法保持乐观。当他情绪低落时——比如说一次课没讲好——他宽容自己，承认自己是凡人。他提醒自己，不是每堂课都有获诺贝尔奖的水准；总会有一些课的效果不如别的课。第二种方法是回顾。他分析讲得不好的课，为以后汲取有用的经验和失败的教训。最后，还有视角问题，要认识到在宏大的生命长卷里，一堂课真的不算什么。

sentences.cn: 大多数人都会把乐观定义为永远快乐，觉得杯子里总有半杯水。

sentences.en: But that's exactly the kind of false cheerfulness that positive psychologists wouldn't recommend.
sentences.cn: 但这恰恰不是真正的快乐，积极心理学家们并不提倡。

sentences.en: "Healthy optimism means being in touch with reality," says Tal Ben-Shahar, a Harvard professor.
sentences.cn: 哈佛大学教授 Tal Ben-Shahar 说："健康的乐观意味着不脱离现实。

sentences.en: According to Ben-Shahar, realistic optimists are those who make the best of things that happen, but not those who believe everything happens for the best.
sentences.cn: "按照 Ben-Shahar 的说法，现实的乐观主义者是那些不管发生什么事情都力求从中得到最大收获的人，而不是那些指望凡事都有最好结局的人。

sentences.en: Ben-Shahar uses three optimistic exercises.
sentences.cn: Ben-Shahar 运用三种方法保持乐观。

sentences.en: When he feels down - say, after giving a bad lecture - he grants himself permission to be human.
sentences.cn: 当他情绪低落时——比如说一次课没讲好——他宽容自己，承认自己是凡人。

sentences.en: He reminds himself that not every lecture can be a Nobel winner; some will be less effective than others.
sentences.cn: 他提醒自己，不是每堂课都有获诺贝尔奖的水准；总会有一些课的效果不如别的课。

sentences.en: Next is reconstruction.

sentences.en: He analyzes the weak lecture, learning lessons for the future about what works and what doesn't.
sentences.cn: 他分析讲得不好的课，为以后汲取有用的经验和失败的教训。

sentences.en: Finally, there is perspective, which involves acknowledging that in the grand scheme of life, one lecture really doesn't matter.

articles.title: Part A 应用文：介绍自己
articles.topic: 小作文：给未来室友写信，介绍生活习惯并征求建议。
articles.sample_en:
Dear John,
I am glad that it is you who will be my roommate during my overseas study and cannot wait to meet you. Before my moving in, I think it is necessary to arrive at a basic understanding about each other's living habits.
As a typical Chinese, I observe traditional living rules, sleeping and getting up early, having gorgeous breakfast, good lunch and humble supper and keeping room tidy and clean. In addition, I prefer cooking Chinese dishes at home and hope to get your tolerance for occasional spicy smell during dish preparation. There must also be some special living rules to be respected in your country. Can you explain them to me in advance? Hope to get your early reply.
Yours,
Li Ming
articles.sample_cn:
亲爱的约翰：
很高兴你是我留学期间的室友，我迫不及待地想要见到你。在我搬进公寓前，我认为必须对各自的生活习惯有个基本了解。
作为一名典型的中国人，我遵循典型的中国生活方式，我会早睡早起，早餐吃好、中餐吃饱、晚餐吃少，并保持房间整洁干净。另外，我喜欢在家做中国菜，希望你能忍受做菜时偶尔会有的辣椒呛人的味道。在你们国家应该也有些需要尊重的生活规范。你能提前向我介绍吗？希望早日收到你的回信。
李明

articles.title: Part B 大作文：城市与乡村人口的变化
articles.topic: 大作文：根据图表写一篇约150词的短文，解读数据并发表评论。
articles.sample_en:
From 1990 to 2010 while moderate increase occurred in total population in China, population distribution experienced a dramatic shift. Urban population increased considerably from 300 million to 670 million; contrastingly rural population declined from 820 million to 680 million.
The population gap narrowed largely because of the joint effects of urbanization and unequal economic opportunities. The 20 years' urban sprawl caused millions of peasants to be passively transformed into city residents. Meanwhile, many more peasants initiatively chose to leave their hometown. In the 20 years, while urban living standards were largely improved, few economic opportunities fell on rural areas, making most peasants remain at the poverty line. Poverty prompted the call for change and healthy young peasants were driven to flock to cities to make a better living.
The increase in urban population is a sure indication of economic achievement. However, we should not ignore the inability of many urban newcomers to integrate into cities due to lack of education and civilized habits. They wandered around in the cities as urban paupers, isolated from cities' prosperity and convenience. In this sense, we cannot be superficially satisfied with the optimistic figure, but should endeavor to foster integration of newcomers.
articles.sample_cn:
1990 年到 2010 年间，中国总人口温和上涨，但人口分布经历了巨大的变化。城市人口从 3 亿上涨到了 6.7 亿，上涨数量可观，与之相对的是农村人口从 8.2 亿下降到 6.8 亿。
（城乡）人口差距缩小主要由于城市化和不公平经济机会的联合作用。20 年的城市扩张导致了数百万农民被动地变为城市居民。同时，更多的农民主动选择离开家乡。20 年里，城市生活水平得到了大幅提高，但农村几乎没有获得经济机会，使大多数农民依然处于贫困中。穷则思变，健康、年轻的农民涌入城市，试图谋得更好的生活。
城市人口的增加无疑是经济成就的一个反映指标。但，我们不能忽视许多城市新居民由于缺乏教育和文明的生活习惯难以融入城市的现实。这些新来者作为城市贫民在城市中游荡，无法享用城市的繁荣和便利。鉴于此，我们不能肤浅地满足于乐观的数据，而应该努力促使新来者融入城市。
